notes: Governing document: the 2014-2018 AAUP-AFT Agreement (effective to June 30, 2018; covers 2018-02-24). Policy 60.3.8 (revisions through 2013) states the NJFLA and FMLA apply to faculty. The two union pages are summaries; 2018_00 is a 2016 capture describing the same Agreement and supplies only the pay detail of the release time ('paid released time') and the timing of the recuperative leave.

Chain, birth parent: recuperative paid leave 6 weeks (c1) -> release from teaching and committee service up to 8 weeks (c2, consecutive_after c1; total up to 14, leave_limits); NJFLA bonding leave 12 weeks (c3) consecutive_after c1 (S1a, N.J.A.C. 13:14-1.6(b)); FMLA 12 weeks (c4) alongside from the start of c1 and overlapping c3.
Chain, non-birth parent: release time up to 8 weeks (c2); NJFLA 12 weeks (c3) with FMLA 12 weeks (c4) concurrent.

FMLA eligibility: Policy 60.3.8 states 1,000 base hours; the statute (29 U.S.C. 2611(2)) requires 1,250 hours. Coded the statute in service_requirement with the policy's figure alongside; no effect on figures (U8).

Documents cited but not saved: Policy 60.3.7 Medical Leave of Absence without Salary; Policy 60.3.9 Pregnancy Policy for Staff Employees; the University's short-term disability / sick-leave policies referred to in Art. XVI.A (not named); N.J.S.A. 34:11B-16 statute text (regulations saved); the union attachment Did_You_Know_Parental_Leave_12_3.pdf; University Regulations and Procedures Manual (Art. XXI); Policies 60.5.1, 60.5.10, 60.5.12 and the Academic Reappointment/Promotion Instructions (not parental).
The union page 2018_00 also reports an NIH policy of 8 paid weeks for NRSA trainees and fellows; not a Rutgers provision, not coded.
Not components: sabbatical program (Art. XXV, study leave), suspension at less than full pay (App. H), twelve-month employment extensions after grievances (Art. X, XIII).

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
